name: globalsend
description: Self-hosted cross-device text and file dock

scripts.setup: node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs server install --frozen-lockfile && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs web install --frozen-lockfile
scripts.build: node scripts/generate-user-guides.mjs --check && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs web run build && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs server run build
scripts.test: node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs server test && node scripts/run-pnpm.mjs web test
